name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task is 'Pick up the key, then reach the goal', which states an order: the goal must be reached only after has_key. The two hard Existence clauses capture both events but not the ordering — the compiled machine pays reward 1 for reaching at_goal before has_key (u0 -> u2) as if it satisfied a subgoal. Add a hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) to record the stated order; keep the hard Existence(at_goal), which with that Precedence already forces has_key, so the hard Existence(has_key) then only repeats it and should be removed.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_goal) requires reaching the goal and Precedence(has_key, at_goal) puts the key pickup before it, which together also force has_key; no redundant Existence needed.

texts: pick up the key before reaching the goal
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 11
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
